name: Alela, Cunning Conqueror — "goad target creature that player controls" waits for the trigger
notes: 2026-11-18, found with detain: the trait-verb parser (goad / suspect / detain) skipped a verb in a permanent's own trigger or activated ability only when its object was not a target, so 30 goad / suspect cards (Alela, Bothersome Quasit, Hot Pursuit, Nelly Borca …) had a targeted Goaded / Suspected effect on the unfired card, a target picker the card itself does not have. Now only the fired trigger has it, as with every other targeted trigger (Trusted Pegasus).
